h1.en: Health Insurance for Rideshare Drivers in New York in 2026: NY State of Health
h1.es: Seguro Medico para Conductores de Viajes Compartidos en Nueva York en 2026: NY State of Health

subhero.en: New York rideshare drivers, delivery drivers, and other gig workers can enroll in Medicaid, the free Essential Plan, or a subsidized Qualified Health Plan through NY State of Health, New York's own ACA marketplace. The Essential Plan remains the biggest advantage for New York gig workers in 2026: a $0-premium option now capped at 200% of the Federal Poverty Level after a July 1, 2026 income-limit reduction from 250%.
subhero.es: Los conductores de viajes compartidos, conductores de entrega y otros trabajadores gig de Nueva York pueden inscribirse en Medicaid, el Essential Plan gratuito, o un Plan de Salud Calificado subsidiado a traves de NY State of Health, el mercado ACA propio de Nueva York. El Essential Plan sigue siendo la mayor ventaja para los trabajadores gig de Nueva York en 2026.

quickAnswer.en: New York gig workers, including Uber drivers, Lyft drivers, DoorDash drivers, and other independent contractors, have three main coverage paths through NY State of Health in 2026. First, Medicaid covers any gig worker with net self-employment income below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 for a single person in 2026) at no cost. Second, the Essential Plan, New York's Basic Health Program, offers $0-premium comprehensive coverage for gig workers between 138% and 200% FPL, though the income ceiling dropped from 250% to 200% FPL on July 1, 2026. Third, rideshare drivers and delivery drivers earning between 200% and 400% FPL can buy a Qualified Health Plan on NY State of Health using the federal Premium Tax Credit (PTC), plus New York's own state-funded cost-sharing reductions that extend through 400% FPL for 2026. TLC-licensed for-hire vehicle drivers affiliated with Uber, Lyft, or a black car base also qualify for the free Black Car Fund Drivers Benefits Program, a supplemental (not primary) benefit covering dental, vision, and telemedicine. The self-employment health insurance deduction (Form 7206) reduces income tax for gig workers with net self-employment income, and an HSA-qualified HDHP adds a triple tax advantage on top.
quickAnswer.es: Los trabajadores gig de Nueva York, incluidos los conductores de Uber, Lyft, DoorDash y otros contratistas independientes, tienen tres caminos principales de cobertura a traves de NY State of Health en 2026. Primero, Medicaid cubre a cualquier trabajador gig con ingreso neto del trabajo independiente por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 para una persona sola en 2026) sin costo. Segundo, el Essential Plan, el Programa Basico de Salud de Nueva York, ofrece cobertura integral con prima de $0 para trabajadores gig entre el 138% y el 200% FPL, aunque el limite de ingresos bajo del 250% al 200% FPL el 1 de julio de 2026. Tercero, los conductores de viajes compartidos y de entrega que ganan entre el 200% y el 400% FPL pueden comprar un Plan de Salud Calificado en NY State of Health usando el Credito Fiscal de Prima (PTC) federal. Los conductores de vehiculos de alquiler con licencia TLC afiliados a Uber, Lyft o una base de black car tambien califican para el Programa de Beneficios para Conductores del Black Car Fund, un beneficio suplementario, no primario.

introParagraphs.en: New York rideshare drivers face a coverage system unlike almost anywhere else in the country because New York runs its own state-based ACA marketplace, NY State of Health, and layers a third option, the Essential Plan, between Medicaid and the standard Qualified Health Plan marketplace. An Uber driver or Lyft driver earning $28,000 a year as an independent contractor in Brooklyn or Buffalo does not face the same binary choice, Medicaid or full-price marketplace insurance, that a gig worker in a federal healthcare.gov state confronts. Instead, New York gig workers between 138% and 200% of the Federal Poverty Level can enroll in the Essential Plan, a comprehensive, $0-premium option that most other states simply do not offer.
introParagraphs.es: Los conductores de viajes compartidos de Nueva York enfrentan un sistema de cobertura diferente al de casi cualquier otro lugar del pais porque Nueva York administra su propio mercado ACA estatal, NY State of Health, y agrega una tercera opcion, el Essential Plan, entre Medicaid y el mercado estandar de Planes de Salud Calificados. Un conductor de Uber o Lyft que gana $28,000 al ano como contratista independiente en Brooklyn o Buffalo no enfrenta la misma eleccion binaria, Medicaid o seguro de mercado a precio completo, que enfrenta un trabajador gig en un estado que usa healthcare.gov. En cambio, los trabajadores gig de Nueva York entre el 138% y el 200% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza pueden inscribirse en el Essential Plan.

introParagraphs.en: New York gig workers, delivery drivers, and DoorDash drivers should also know about a driver-specific benefit that has no equivalent under most other states' gig-economy laws: the Black Car Fund. TLC-licensed for-hire vehicle drivers dispatched through Uber, Lyft, or a traditional black car base receive workers' compensation coverage plus a free supplemental Drivers Benefits Program covering dental, vision, and telemedicine, funded by a small per-trip passenger surcharge rather than a stipend paid directly to drivers like California's Proposition 22. This guide walks through Medicaid, the Essential Plan, Qualified Health Plan subsidies, the Form 7206 self-employment health insurance deduction, HSA eligibility, the Black Car Fund, catastrophic plan rules, and the Marketplace Special Enrollment Period triggers that matter most for New York independent contractors in 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig, conductores de entrega y conductores de DoorDash de Nueva York tambien deben conocer un beneficio especifico para conductores que no tiene equivalente en la mayoria de las leyes de la economia gig de otros estados: el Black Car Fund. Los conductores de vehiculos de alquiler con licencia TLC despachados a traves de Uber, Lyft o una base de black car tradicional reciben cobertura de compensacion laboral ademas de un Programa de Beneficios para Conductores suplementario y gratuito que cubre dental, vision y telemedicina, financiado por un pequeno recargo por viaje pagado por los pasajeros.

footnote.en: New York's Essential Plan dropped its income ceiling from 250% FPL to 200% FPL effective July 1, 2026, but kept $0 monthly premiums for everyone who remains eligible. Federal enhanced Premium Tax Credits from ARPA/IRA expired January 1, 2026, restoring the 400% FPL subsidy cliff nationwide, but New York's own state-funded cost-sharing reductions continue extending value up to 400% FPL through 2026.
footnote.es: El Essential Plan de Nueva York redujo su limite de ingresos del 250% FPL al 200% FPL a partir del 1 de julio de 2026, pero mantuvo primas mensuales de $0 para todos los que siguen siendo elegibles. Los Creditos Fiscales de Prima federales mejorados de ARPA/IRA vencieron el 1 de enero de 2026.

optionsOverview.source: NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), NYS Department of Health, KFF

heading.en: Option 1: Medicaid Through NY State of Health
heading.es: Opcion 1: Medicaid a Traves de NY State of Health

paragraphs.en: New York Medicaid covers gig workers, rideshare drivers, delivery drivers, and other independent contractors who earn at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. In 2026, that threshold is $22,025 per year for a single adult, $29,864 for a household of two. Unlike most healthcare.gov states, New York enrolls Medicaid directly through NY State of Health, the same portal used for the Essential Plan and Qualified Health Plans, so a rideshare driver never has to visit a separate state Medicaid site. New York Medicaid covers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and mental health services with no premium and minimal cost sharing. Gig workers calculate income using net self-employment income: gross 1099 earnings minus allowable business expenses, including mileage at the 2026 IRS rate of $0.725 per mile, phone, data plans, and vehicle costs allocated to business use.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de Nueva York cubre a trabajadores gig, conductores de viajes compartidos, conductores de entrega y otros contratistas independientes que ganan en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. En 2026, ese umbral es de $22,025 al ano para un adulto soltero. A diferencia de la mayoria de los estados que usan healthcare.gov, Nueva York inscribe a Medicaid directamente a traves de NY State of Health, el mismo portal usado para el Essential Plan y los Planes de Salud Calificados.

paragraphs.en: A DoorDash driver or Instacart shopper in New York City grossing $27,000 but deducting $6,500 in eligible mileage and equipment expenses may land at a MAGI below $22,025 and qualify for New York Medicaid at no cost. New York Medicaid enrollment is available year-round with no open enrollment restriction, so a gig worker whose income drops mid-year, for example after a slow winter for a Lyft driver or a seasonal dip for a delivery driver, can enroll in Medicaid as soon as the income change is reported to NY State of Health.
paragraphs.es: Un conductor de DoorDash o comprador de Instacart en la ciudad de Nueva York que gana $27,000 brutos pero deduce $6,500 en gastos elegibles de kilometraje y equipo puede quedar con un MAGI por debajo de $22,025 y calificar para Medicaid de Nueva York sin costo. La inscripcion a Medicaid de Nueva York esta disponible todo el ano sin restriccion de inscripcion abierta.

heading.en: Option 2: The Essential Plan, New York's Free Basic Health Program
heading.es: Opcion 2: El Essential Plan, el Programa Basico de Salud Gratuito de Nueva York

paragraphs.en: The Essential Plan is New York's Basic Health Program, a coverage tier authorized under Section 1331 of the Affordable Care Act that exists in only a handful of states. For 2026, the Essential Plan covers New York residents ages 19 to 64 with household income between 138% and 200% of the Federal Poverty Level, meaning between $22,025 and $31,920 for a single person. New York cut the Essential Plan's income ceiling from 250% FPL to 200% FPL effective July 1, 2026, but every enrollee who remains eligible keeps a $0 monthly premium with no deductible. The Essential Plan covers comprehensive benefits including dental, vision, inpatient and outpatient hospital care, and prescription drugs, making it a stronger deal than most subsidized Qualified Health Plans for New York gig workers in this income band.
paragraphs.es: El Essential Plan es el Programa Basico de Salud de Nueva York, un nivel de cobertura autorizado bajo la Seccion 1331 de la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible que existe en solo unos pocos estados. Para 2026, el Essential Plan cubre a residentes de Nueva York de 19 a 64 anos con ingreso familiar entre el 138% y el 200% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Nueva York redujo el limite de ingresos del Essential Plan del 250% FPL al 200% FPL a partir del 1 de julio de 2026, pero cada inscrito que sigue siendo elegible mantiene una prima mensual de $0.

paragraphs.en: A rideshare driver or delivery driver in the Essential Plan income band should apply through NY State of Health rather than shopping a Qualified Health Plan, since the Essential Plan's $0 premium beats any subsidized marketplace plan at the same income level. A New York gig worker whose net self-employment income rises above 200% FPL mid-year, for instance an Uber driver who picks up more hours during holiday season, must transition to a Qualified Health Plan with a federal Premium Tax Credit, and should report the income change to NY State of Health within 30 days to avoid a coverage gap or a tax-time reconciliation surprise.
paragraphs.es: Un conductor de viajes compartidos o de entrega en la banda de ingresos del Essential Plan debe solicitar a traves de NY State of Health en lugar de comprar un Plan de Salud Calificado, ya que la prima de $0 del Essential Plan supera a cualquier plan de mercado subsidiado al mismo nivel de ingresos.

heading.en: Option 3: Qualified Health Plan With Federal Premium Tax Credit
heading.es: Opcion 3: Plan de Salud Calificado Con Credito Fiscal de Prima Federal

paragraphs.en: New York gig workers earning between 200% and 400% FPL no longer qualify for the Essential Plan after the July 1, 2026 income-cap reduction, so they shop for a Qualified Health Plan (QHP) on NY State of Health using the federal Premium Tax Credit (PTC). For 2026, the subsidy phases down as income climbs toward 400% FPL ($63,840 single, $132,000 for a household of four) and stops entirely at 400%. New York also funds its own state-level cost-sharing reductions that extend value through 400% FPL for 2026, on top of the federal PTC, softening some of the impact from the expired ARPA and Inflation Reduction Act enhanced subsidies. A rideshare driver at 300% FPL ($47,880 single) typically sees a benchmark Silver plan premium in the range of $200 to $350 per month after the federal PTC is applied.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig de Nueva York que ganan entre el 200% y el 400% FPL ya no califican para el Essential Plan despues de la reduccion del limite de ingresos del 1 de julio de 2026, por lo que compran un Plan de Salud Calificado (QHP) en NY State of Health usando el Credito Fiscal de Prima (PTC) federal. Para 2026, el subsidio disminuye a medida que los ingresos suben hacia el 400% FPL. Nueva York tambien financia sus propias reducciones de costos compartidos a nivel estatal que extienden el valor hasta el 400% FPL para 2026.

paragraphs.en: When enrolling in a QHP as a 1099 contractor or sole proprietor, project net income, not gross income, for MAGI estimation. NY State of Health distributes advance Premium Tax Credits monthly, and any over- or underpayment reconciles on Form 1095-A at tax time using IRS Form 8962. A Lyft driver or DoorDash driver whose weekly hours fluctuate should update projected income on NY State of Health as soon as a meaningful change occurs, because underpaid credits create a tax bill the following April, and overpaid credits mean leaving affordability on the table every month.
paragraphs.es: Al inscribirse en un QHP como contratista 1099 o propietario unico, proyecte el ingreso neto, no el bruto, para la estimacion del MAGI. NY State of Health distribuye Creditos Fiscales de Prima anticipados mensualmente, y cualquier pago excesivo o insuficiente se reconcilia en el Formulario 1095-A al momento de declarar impuestos usando el Formulario 8962 del IRS.

heading.en: Option 4: HSA-Qualified HDHP for Higher-Earning New York Independent Contractors
heading.es: Opcion 4: HDHP Compatible con HSA para Contratistas Independientes de Nueva York de Mayores Ingresos

paragraphs.en: New York gig workers and independent contractors earning above 400% FPL ($63,840 single, $132,000 for a family of four in 2026) receive no federal Premium Tax Credit and no Essential Plan support. At this income level, an HSA-qualified High-Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) available on NY State of Health is usually the most cost-effective structure. The 2026 HDHP minimum deductible is $1,700 for self-only coverage or $3,400 for family coverage. Pairing an HDHP with a Health Savings Account (HSA) adds the triple tax advantage: contributions deduct above the line, up to $4,400 self-only or $8,750 family in 2026, plus a $1,000 catch-up for those 55 and older, growth is tax-free, and qualified medical withdrawals are tax-free.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig y contratistas independientes de Nueva York que ganan por encima del 400% FPL no reciben Credito Fiscal de Prima federal ni apoyo del Essential Plan. A este nivel de ingresos, un HDHP compatible con HSA disponible en NY State of Health suele ser la estructura mas rentable. El deducible minimo del HDHP para 2026 es $1,700 individual o $3,400 familia.

intro.en: New York gig workers, rideshare drivers, and delivery drivers face aggressive marketing from non-ACA products and misunderstandings about driver-specific benefits. These are the ones that look affordable or automatic and cause the most financial damage:
intro.es: Los trabajadores gig, conductores de viajes compartidos y conductores de entrega de Nueva York enfrentan marketing agresivo de productos no ACA y confusiones sobre los beneficios especificos para conductores. Estas son las que parecen accesibles o automaticas y causan el mayor dano financiero:

en: Assuming the Black Car Fund replaces the need for health insurance

The Black Car Fund provides workers' compensation for on-the-job injuries and a free supplemental Drivers Benefits Program (dental, vision, telemedicine, accident and critical illness benefits). It is not major medical insurance and does not cover routine doctor visits, hospitalization, or prescriptions the way a plan through NY State of Health does.
es: Asumir que el Black Car Fund reemplaza la necesidad de un seguro medico

El Black Car Fund proporciona compensacion laboral por lesiones en el trabajo y un Programa de Beneficios para Conductores suplementario gratuito. No es un seguro medico mayor y no cubre visitas rutinarias al medico, hospitalizacion o recetas como lo hace un plan de NY State of Health.

en: Do not cover pre-existing conditions and can rescind retroactively. A New York rideshare driver comparing a cheap short-term plan against the free Essential Plan is almost always making a mistake, since the Essential Plan is $0 in premium up to 200% FPL and covers far more.
es: Planes a corto plazo de duracion limitada

No cubren condiciones preexistentes y pueden cancelarse retroactivamente. Un conductor de viajes compartidos de Nueva York que compara un plan barato a corto plazo con el Essential Plan gratuito casi siempre esta cometiendo un error.

en: NOT insurance. No legal obligation to pay claims. Pre-existing conditions excluded and lifestyle clauses can disqualify entire care categories. New York independent contractors eligible for the free Essential Plan have no reason to consider a health share ministry.
es: NO son seguro. Sin obligacion legal de pagar reclamos. Condiciones preexistentes excluidas. Los contratistas independientes de Nueva York elegibles para el Essential Plan gratuito no tienen razon para considerar un ministerio de compartir salud.

en: Missing the July 1, 2026 Essential Plan income-cap change

A gig worker earning between 200% and 250% FPL who assumed they still qualified for the Essential Plan after July 1, 2026 could lose coverage without applying for a Qualified Health Plan with the federal Premium Tax Credit in time, risking a gap in coverage.
es: Pasar por alto el cambio del limite de ingresos del Essential Plan del 1 de julio de 2026

Un trabajador gig que gana entre el 200% y el 250% FPL y asumio que todavia calificaba para el Essential Plan despues del 1 de julio de 2026 podria perder la cobertura sin solicitar a tiempo un Plan de Salud Calificado con el PTC federal.

footnote.en: Verify any plan is offered through NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov) or confirm Black Car Fund benefits directly with nybcf.org. If a broker pitches something cheaper that is not on NY State of Health, ask for the plan's Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC) certification.
footnote.es: Verifique que cualquier plan se ofrezca a traves de NY State of Health o confirme los beneficios del Black Car Fund directamente en nybcf.org. Si un agente ofrece algo mas barato que no esta en NY State of Health, solicite la certificacion de Cobertura Esencial Minima (MEC) del plan.

traps.source: NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov), The Black Car Fund (nybcf.org), KFF

heading.en: The Black Car Fund and Drivers Benefits Program for New York Rideshare Drivers
heading.es: El Black Car Fund y el Programa de Beneficios para Conductores de Nueva York

paragraphs.en: New York's Black Car Fund, established under New York State law in 1999, provides workers' compensation coverage to for-hire vehicle drivers dispatched through a member base, including Uber and Lyft drivers classified as Transportation Network Company drivers, traditional black car and livery drivers, and TLC-licensed high-volume for-hire vehicle drivers. The Fund is financed by a small surcharge assessed on the total fare, excluding tips, tolls, and airport fees, so New York gig workers pay nothing directly. Unlike California's Proposition 22, which pays a quarterly cash stipend directly to drivers to fund a health plan, New York's Black Car Fund model provides workers' compensation for on-the-job injuries plus a separate, free Drivers Benefits Program covering dental insurance, vision coverage, telemedicine, accident disability insurance, and a critical illness benefit.
paragraphs.es: El Black Car Fund de Nueva York, establecido bajo la ley del Estado de Nueva York en 1999, proporciona cobertura de compensacion laboral a conductores de vehiculos de alquiler despachados a traves de una base miembro, incluidos los conductores de Uber y Lyft clasificados como conductores de Compania de Red de Transporte, conductores tradicionales de black car y livery, y conductores de vehiculos de alquiler de alto volumen con licencia TLC. El Fondo se financia con un pequeno recargo sobre la tarifa total, excluyendo propinas, peajes y tarifas aeroportuarias.

paragraphs.en: The Black Car Fund's Drivers Benefits Program is not a substitute for major medical health insurance. A TLC-licensed driver, black car driver, or rideshare driver still needs primary coverage through Medicaid, the Essential Plan, or a Qualified Health Plan on NY State of Health to cover doctor visits, hospitalization, surgery, and prescription drugs beyond the supplemental dental, vision, and telemedicine benefits the Fund provides at no cost. New York gig workers should register for the Drivers Benefits Program through their base or at ny.driversbenefits.org in addition to, not instead of, enrolling in a NY State of Health plan.
paragraphs.es: El Programa de Beneficios para Conductores del Black Car Fund no es un sustituto de un seguro medico mayor. Un conductor con licencia TLC, conductor de black car o conductor de viajes compartidos todavia necesita cobertura primaria a traves de Medicaid, el Essential Plan o un Plan de Salud Calificado en NY State of Health. Los trabajadores gig de Nueva York deben registrarse en el Programa de Beneficios para Conductores ademas de, no en lugar de, inscribirse en un plan de NY State of Health.

paragraphs.en: New York also enacted the statewide Freelance Isn't Free Act, effective August 28, 2024, which requires any business hiring a freelancer for work worth $800 or more within 120 days to provide a written contract and pay within 30 days. The law is a payment-protection statute for freelancers and independent contractors; it does not create a health insurance benefit, but it is worth knowing alongside the Black Car Fund because both reflect New York's broader push to formalize protections for 1099 contractors, sole proprietors, and other gig economy workers who fall outside traditional employer benefits.
paragraphs.es: Nueva York tambien promulgo la Ley Freelance Isn't Free en todo el estado, vigente desde el 28 de agosto de 2024, que requiere que cualquier empresa que contrate a un freelancer por trabajo de $800 o mas dentro de 120 dias proporcione un contrato por escrito y pague dentro de 30 dias. La ley es un estatuto de proteccion de pago para freelancers y contratistas independientes; no crea un beneficio de seguro medico.

heading.en: Premium Tax Credit (PTC) Eligibility for New York Gig Workers in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad para el Credito Fiscal de Prima (PTC) para Trabajadores Gig de Nueva York en 2026

paragraphs.en: New York gig workers, rideshare drivers, and delivery drivers projecting their 2026 NY State of Health eligibility need to track two thresholds instead of one, because New York inserts the Essential Plan between Medicaid and the standard federal Premium Tax Credit (PTC) band. Below 138% FPL, Medicaid applies. Between 138% and 200% FPL, the Essential Plan applies with a $0 premium. Above 200% FPL and up to 400% FPL, the federal PTC phases down as income climbs, reaching zero at exactly 400% FPL, which is $63,840 for a single New Yorker and $132,000 for a household of four in 2026. Above 400%, a New York gig worker pays the full benchmark premium with no federal help, though New York's own state-funded cost-sharing reductions continue to add value through 400% FPL for 2026.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig, conductores de viajes compartidos y conductores de entrega de Nueva York que proyectan su elegibilidad para NY State of Health en 2026 necesitan rastrear dos umbrales en lugar de uno, porque Nueva York inserta el Essential Plan entre Medicaid y la banda estandar del Credito Fiscal de Prima (PTC) federal. Por debajo del 138% FPL, aplica Medicaid. Entre el 138% y el 200% FPL, aplica el Essential Plan con prima de $0. Por encima del 200% FPL y hasta el 400% FPL, el PTC federal disminuye a medida que los ingresos suben.

paragraphs.en: MAGI for NY State of Health purposes is net self-employment income plus any other income sources. For a rideshare driver or delivery driver, MAGI equals gross 1099 platform earnings minus eligible business deductions, including mileage at the 2026 IRS rate of $0.725 per mile, cell phone costs, vehicle insurance allocated to business use, and equipment, minus half of self-employment tax, minus the self-employed health insurance deduction (Form 7206). An Uber driver grossing $38,000 with $7,500 in deductions, $2,200 in the SE tax half-deduction, and $5,500 in premiums deducted through Form 7206 could land at a MAGI near $22,800, just above the Medicaid line and inside the Essential Plan's $0-premium band.
paragraphs.es: El MAGI para los propositos de NY State of Health es el ingreso neto del trabajo independiente mas cualquier otra fuente de ingresos. Para un conductor de viajes compartidos o de entrega, el MAGI equivale a las ganancias brutas 1099 de la plataforma menos las deducciones comerciales elegibles, incluyendo el kilometraje a la tasa del IRS de $0.725 por milla en 2026, menos la mitad del impuesto al trabajo independiente, menos la deduccion de seguro medico del Formulario 7206.

heading.en: 2026 Medicaid, Essential Plan, and Subsidy Cliff Income Limits for New York Gig Workers by Household Size
heading.es: Limites de Ingresos de Medicaid, Essential Plan y Limite de Subsidio 2026 para Trabajadores Gig de Nueva York por Tamano del Hogar

paragraphs.en: New York gig workers, rideshare drivers, delivery drivers, and independent contractors can use the table below to find their income bracket on NY State of Health for 2026. Medicaid covers anyone in New York below 138% FPL. The Essential Plan covers New York residents between 138% and 200% FPL with a $0 monthly premium, following the July 1, 2026 reduction from the prior 250% FPL ceiling. The federal Premium Tax Credit phases down between 200% and 400% FPL and stops above 400% FPL. All figures below are 2026 annual MAGI, meaning net self-employment income, not gross 1099 earnings.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig, conductores de viajes compartidos, conductores de entrega y contratistas independientes de Nueva York pueden usar la tabla a continuacion para encontrar su banda de ingresos en NY State of Health para 2026. Medicaid cubre a cualquier persona en Nueva York por debajo del 138% FPL. El Essential Plan cubre a los residentes de Nueva York entre el 138% y el 200% FPL con una prima mensual de $0.

footnote.en: Income is annual net MAGI (gross 1099 earnings minus business deductions, minus half of SE tax, minus Form 7206 premium deduction). New York's Essential Plan income cap dropped from 250% FPL to 200% FPL effective July 1, 2026. Source: HHS ASPE 2026 Poverty Guidelines; NY State of Health Essential Plan income guidelines.
footnote.es: El ingreso es el MAGI neto anual (ganancias brutas 1099 menos deducciones comerciales, menos la mitad del impuesto SE, menos la deduccion de primas del Formulario 7206). El limite de ingresos del Essential Plan de Nueva York bajo del 250% FPL al 200% FPL a partir del 1 de julio de 2026.

heading.en: Self-Employment Health Insurance Deduction (Form 7206) for New York Gig Workers
heading.es: Deduccion de Seguro Medico para Trabajadores Independientes (Formulario 7206) para Trabajadores Gig de Nueva York

paragraphs.en: Form 7206 lets New York gig workers, independent contractors, and sole proprietors deduct 100% of health insurance premiums paid for themselves, their spouse, and dependents as an above-the-line adjustment on Schedule 1, line 17 of Form 1040. This deduction reduces federal income tax and, because New York State tax returns start from federal adjusted gross income, New York State income tax as well. Form 7206 reduces income tax only. It does NOT reduce self-employment tax calculated on Schedule SE. The 15.3% self-employment tax, made up of 12.4% Social Security and 2.9% Medicare, is calculated on net self-employment earnings before the health insurance deduction is applied, so the deduction never touches Schedule SE.
paragraphs.es: El Formulario 7206 permite a los trabajadores gig, contratistas independientes y propietarios unicos de Nueva York deducir el 100% de las primas de seguro medico pagadas por ellos mismos, su conyuge y dependientes como ajuste sobre la linea en el Schedule 1, linea 17 del Formulario 1040. Esta deduccion reduce el impuesto sobre la renta federal y el impuesto estatal de Nueva York. El Formulario 7206 reduce el impuesto sobre la renta solamente. NO reduce el impuesto al trabajo independiente calculado en el Schedule SE.

paragraphs.en: For a 1099 contractor or Uber driver paying $350 per month in Qualified Health Plan premiums ($4,200 annually) on NY State of Health, the Form 7206 deduction at the 22% federal bracket saves approximately $924 in federal income tax per year, with additional New York State income tax savings on top. The deduction also lowers MAGI, which can move a New York gig worker back into the Essential Plan's income band or improve the federal PTC for the following year. Two limits apply: the deduction cannot exceed net self-employment earnings minus half of self-employment tax, and any month during which the contractor or their spouse was eligible for employer-sponsored coverage disqualifies that month's premium from the deduction. Most New York rideshare drivers and delivery drivers with no employer coverage available qualify for the full deduction every month.
paragraphs.es: Para un contratista 1099 o conductor de Uber que paga $350 al mes en primas de un Plan de Salud Calificado ($4,200 anuales) en NY State of Health, la deduccion del Formulario 7206 al rango federal del 22% ahorra aproximadamente $924 en impuesto sobre la renta federal por ano, con ahorros adicionales de impuesto estatal de Nueva York. La deduccion tambien reduce el MAGI, lo que puede devolver a un trabajador gig de Nueva York a la banda de ingresos del Essential Plan.

heading.en: HSA and HDHP Fit for New York Gig Workers in 2026
heading.es: Compatibilidad de HSA y HDHP para Trabajadores Gig de Nueva York en 2026

paragraphs.en: New York gig workers and independent contractors enrolled in an HSA-qualified High-Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) on NY State of Health can open and contribute to a Health Savings Account (HSA). For 2026, an HDHP must have a minimum deductible of $1,700 for self-only coverage or $3,400 for family coverage, with a maximum out-of-pocket of $8,500 self-only or $17,000 family. The 2026 HSA contribution limit is $4,400 for self-only coverage and $8,750 for family coverage, plus a $1,000 catch-up contribution for those age 55 and older. HSA contributions offer the triple tax advantage: contributions are deductible above the line for both federal and New York State income tax, growth is tax-free inside the account, and qualified medical withdrawals are completely tax-free.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig e independientes de Nueva York inscritos en un Plan de Deducible Alto (HDHP) compatible con HSA en NY State of Health pueden abrir y contribuir a una Cuenta de Ahorros para la Salud (HSA). Para 2026, un HDHP debe tener un deducible minimo de $1,700 para cobertura individual o $3,400 para cobertura familiar. El limite de contribucion al HSA para 2026 es $4,400 individual y $8,750 familia, mas $1,000 de aporte adicional para los mayores de 55 anos.

paragraphs.en: A Flexible Spending Account (FSA) is an employer-sponsored benefit only. Most New York gig workers, rideshare drivers, DoorDash drivers, and other independent contractors do NOT have access to an FSA because they work as 1099 contractors rather than W-2 employees. FSA is not an option for a sole proprietor or independent contractor shopping NY State of Health on their own. The HSA is the tax-advantaged medical savings vehicle available to New York independent contractors, but only when paired with a qualifying HDHP; not every HDHP-labeled plan on NY State of Health is HSA-compatible, so check the plan details before enrolling.
paragraphs.es: Una Cuenta de Gastos Flexibles (FSA) es un beneficio exclusivo del empleador. La mayoria de los trabajadores gig, conductores de viajes compartidos, conductores de DoorDash y otros contratistas independientes de Nueva York NO tienen acceso a una FSA porque trabajan como contratistas 1099 en lugar de empleados W-2. El HSA es el instrumento de ahorro medico con ventajas fiscales disponible para los contratistas independientes de Nueva York, pero solo cuando se combina con un HDHP calificado.

heading.en: Marketplace Special Enrollment Period (SEP) Triggers for New York Gig Workers
heading.es: Activadores del Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) del Mercado para Trabajadores Gig de Nueva York

paragraphs.en: NY State of Health open enrollment for Qualified Health Plans runs November 1 through January 31 each year for coverage starting the following year. Outside open enrollment, a New York gig worker can enroll in a Qualified Health Plan only if they qualify for a Marketplace Special Enrollment Period (SEP), which opens a 60-day window from the date of the qualifying event. Medicaid and the Essential Plan, unlike Qualified Health Plans, are available year-round on NY State of Health with no SEP required, which matters for rideshare drivers and delivery drivers whose income frequently crosses the Medicaid or Essential Plan thresholds mid-year.
paragraphs.es: La inscripcion abierta de NY State of Health para Planes de Salud Calificados se extiende del 1 de noviembre al 31 de enero de cada ano. Fuera de la inscripcion abierta, un trabajador gig de Nueva York solo puede inscribirse en un Plan de Salud Calificado si califica para un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) del Mercado, que abre una ventana de 60 dias desde la fecha del evento calificador. Medicaid y el Essential Plan estan disponibles todo el ano en NY State of Health sin necesidad de SEP.

paragraphs.en: A New York gig worker moving between Medicaid, the Essential Plan, and a Qualified Health Plan mid-year should report the change to NY State of Health as soon as it happens, since crossing the 138% FPL or 200% FPL threshold in either direction can shift the household from one program to another automatically. For a delivery driver or rideshare driver with seasonal or variable earnings, this income-change trigger is the most common reason to touch NY State of Health outside the normal open enrollment window.
paragraphs.es: Un trabajador gig de Nueva York que se mueve entre Medicaid, el Essential Plan y un Plan de Salud Calificado a mitad de ano debe reportar el cambio a NY State of Health tan pronto como ocurra, ya que cruzar el umbral del 138% FPL o del 200% FPL en cualquier direccion puede cambiar al hogar de un programa a otro automaticamente.

list.en: Loss of other coverage (losing Medicaid, losing a family member's employer plan, end of COBRA): 60-day SEP window
list.es: Perdida de otra cobertura (perder Medicaid, perder el plan del empleador de un familiar, fin de COBRA): ventana SEP de 60 dias

list.en: Income change crossing the 138% FPL Medicaid threshold or the 200% FPL Essential Plan threshold (either direction): automatic program transition, no SEP needed
list.es: Cambio de ingresos que cruza el umbral de Medicaid del 138% FPL o el umbral del Essential Plan del 200% FPL (en cualquier direccion): transicion automatica de programa, no se necesita SEP

list.en: Marriage or divorce: 60-day SEP to add or remove a spouse from a Qualified Health Plan
list.es: Matrimonio o divorcio: SEP de 60 dias para agregar o quitar a un conyuge de un Plan de Salud Calificado

list.en: Birth or adoption of a child: 60-day SEP; newborns can be added retroactively from the date of birth
list.es: Nacimiento o adopcion de un hijo: SEP de 60 dias; los recien nacidos pueden agregarse retroactivamente desde la fecha de nacimiento

heading.en: How to Apply for Health Insurance as a New York Gig Worker in 2026
heading.es: Como Solicitar Seguro Medico como Trabajador Gig en Nueva York en 2026

paragraphs.en: New York gig workers, rideshare drivers, and delivery drivers apply for Medicaid, the Essential Plan, and Qualified Health Plans through the same portal: nystateofhealth.ny.gov or by calling 1-855-355-5777. Medicaid and Essential Plan enrollment are available year-round; Qualified Health Plan open enrollment runs November 1 through January 31. The application asks for projected annual net income, household size, immigration status, and current coverage status, and the system routes each applicant to Medicaid, the Essential Plan, or a Qualified Health Plan automatically based on income.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig, conductores de viajes compartidos y conductores de entrega de Nueva York solicitan Medicaid, el Essential Plan y los Planes de Salud Calificados a traves del mismo portal: nystateofhealth.ny.gov o llamando al 1-855-355-5777. La inscripcion a Medicaid y al Essential Plan esta disponible todo el ano; la inscripcion abierta de Planes de Salud Calificados se extiende del 1 de noviembre al 31 de enero.

list.en: Step 1: Visit nystateofhealth.ny.gov or call 1-855-355-5777. Create or log into your NY State of Health account.
list.es: Paso 1: Visita nystateofhealth.ny.gov o llama al 1-855-355-5777. Crea o inicia sesion en tu cuenta de NY State of Health.

list.en: Step 2: Enter household size and projected 2026 net self-employment income (gross 1099 platform earnings minus business expenses like mileage, phone, and equipment).
list.es: Paso 2: Ingresa el tamano del hogar y el ingreso neto proyectado del trabajo independiente para 2026 (ganancias brutas 1099 de la plataforma menos gastos comerciales).

list.en: Step 3: The system routes you to Medicaid (below 138% FPL), the Essential Plan (138 to 200% FPL), or Qualified Health Plan shopping with the federal PTC (200 to 400% FPL, or full price above 400% FPL).
list.es: Paso 3: El sistema te dirige a Medicaid (por debajo del 138% FPL), el Essential Plan (138 a 200% FPL) o la compra de un Plan de Salud Calificado con el PTC federal (200 a 400% FPL, o precio completo por encima del 400% FPL).

list.en: Step 4: If shopping a Qualified Health Plan, compare Bronze (lowest premium, HSA-compatible options available), Silver (cost-sharing reductions available at lower incomes), Gold (richer benefits, higher premium), and Catastrophic (under 30 or hardship exemption only).
list.es: Paso 4: Si compras un Plan de Salud Calificado, compara Bronze (prima mas baja, opciones compatibles con HSA disponibles), Silver (reducciones de costos compartidos disponibles), Gold (beneficios mas ricos) y Catastrofico (solo menores de 30 anos o exencion por dificultad).

list.en: Step 5: If a TLC-licensed driver, separately register for the free Black Car Fund Drivers Benefits Program at ny.driversbenefits.org. Confirm enrollment and expect Form 1095-A from NY State of Health in January to reconcile any federal PTC on IRS Form 8962.
list.es: Paso 5: Si eres un conductor con licencia TLC, registrate por separado en el Programa de Beneficios para Conductores gratuito del Black Car Fund en ny.driversbenefits.org. Confirma la inscripcion y espera el Formulario 1095-A de NY State of Health en enero.

heading.en: Catastrophic Plan Eligibility for New York Gig Workers
heading.es: Elegibilidad para Planes Catastroficos para Trabajadores Gig de Nueva York

paragraphs.en: Catastrophic health plans on NY State of Health are available to New York gig workers who are either under age 30, or of any age with a hardship exemption, for example a rideshare driver who cannot afford any other marketplace plan or who has significant unpaid medical debt. The 2026 catastrophic plan deductible equals the ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum, $10,600 for individual coverage. After the deductible is met, the plan covers all essential health benefits at no additional cost. Catastrophic plans on NY State of Health do NOT qualify for the federal Premium Tax Credit or the Essential Plan, so the premium is paid entirely out of pocket, typically $140 to $320 per month for a young adult in New York.
paragraphs.es: Los planes de salud catastroficos en NY State of Health estan disponibles para los trabajadores gig de Nueva York que son menores de 30 anos, o de cualquier edad con una exencion por dificultad, por ejemplo un conductor de viajes compartidos que no puede pagar ningun otro plan del mercado o que tiene deuda medica significativa sin pagar. El deducible del plan catastrofico de 2026 es igual al maximo de bolsillo del mercado ACA, $10,600 para cobertura individual.

paragraphs.en: New York gig workers over age 30 without a documented hardship exemption are NOT eligible for a catastrophic plan on NY State of Health. A 34-year-old delivery driver looking for the cheapest coverage in New York should instead compare Medicaid, the Essential Plan, or a Bronze HDHP eligible for the federal PTC, since those options usually beat a catastrophic plan on both cost and coverage for anyone earning under 400% FPL.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores gig de Nueva York mayores de 30 anos sin una exencion por dificultad documentada NO son elegibles para un plan catastrofico en NY State of Health. Un conductor de entrega de 34 anos que busca la cobertura mas barata en Nueva York deberia comparar Medicaid, el Essential Plan o un HDHP Bronze elegible para el PTC federal en su lugar.

en.question: What's the cheapest health insurance for rideshare drivers in New York in 2026?
en.answer: For New York gig workers earning below $22,025 (single) in 2026, Medicaid through NY State of Health is free with no premium. Between 138% and 200% FPL ($22,025 to $31,920 single), the Essential Plan offers comprehensive coverage with a $0 monthly premium, though the income cap dropped from 250% to 200% FPL on July 1, 2026. Above 200% and up to 400% FPL, a Qualified Health Plan with the federal Premium Tax Credit is the next-cheapest option, and New York's own state-funded cost-sharing reductions add value up to 400% FPL. Above 400% FPL, an HSA-qualified HDHP is usually the most cost-effective choice for New York rideshare and delivery drivers.

en.question: Do New York gig workers qualify for the Premium Tax Credit?
en.answer: Yes, if annual net MAGI falls between 200% and 400% FPL, which is $31,920 to $63,840 for a single New York gig worker in 2026. Below 200% FPL, New York gig workers instead qualify for the free Essential Plan (138% to 200% FPL) or Medicaid (below 138% FPL), both of which typically offer better value than a subsidized Qualified Health Plan. Net MAGI is gross 1099 income minus business deductions, minus half of self-employment tax, minus the Form 7206 health insurance premium deduction. The federal PTC phases down as income approaches 400% FPL and stops entirely at that point.

en.question: Can New York gig workers deduct health insurance premiums on taxes?
en.answer: Yes, if they have net self-employment income and were not eligible for employer-sponsored coverage in a given month. Form 7206 lets New York rideshare drivers, independent contractors, and sole proprietors deduct 100% of health insurance premiums above the line, reducing both federal income tax and New York State income tax. Important: Form 7206 reduces income tax only. It does NOT reduce the 15.3% self-employment tax on Schedule SE. The self-employment tax is calculated on net earnings before the health insurance premium deduction is applied, so the Form 7206 benefit never touches Schedule SE.

en.question: Can New York gig workers use a Health Savings Account (HSA)?
en.answer: Yes, if enrolled in a qualifying HSA-compatible HDHP through NY State of Health. For 2026, the HDHP minimum deductible is $1,700 for self-only coverage or $3,400 for family coverage. The HSA contribution limit in 2026 is $4,400 (self-only) or $8,750 (family), plus a $1,000 catch-up for those 55 or older. A Flexible Spending Account (FSA) is employer-only and is NOT available to New York independent contractors, rideshare drivers, or delivery drivers working as 1099 contractors. The HSA is the tax-advantaged medical savings account available to New York gig workers.

en.question: What if a New York gig worker makes too much for the Essential Plan or subsidies?
en.answer: New York gig workers earning above 400% FPL ($63,840 single, $132,000 for a household of four in 2026) receive zero federal Premium Tax Credits. Enhanced ARPA and Inflation Reduction Act subsidies expired January 1, 2026. At that income level, the most tax-efficient strategy is a Bronze HDHP on NY State of Health paired with a maxed HSA ($4,400 self / $8,750 family). The Form 7206 deduction still reduces income tax, and the HSA triple tax advantage layers on top. Rideshare drivers near the 200% FPL Essential Plan cutoff or the 400% FPL cliff should time HSA contributions and Form 7206 deductions to manage MAGI carefully.

en.question: When can New York gig workers enroll in a Qualified Health Plan outside open enrollment?
en.answer: Outside the November 1 to January 31 open enrollment window, New York gig workers can enroll in a Qualified Health Plan through a Marketplace Special Enrollment Period (SEP), which opens a 60-day window from the qualifying event. Common triggers for rideshare drivers and delivery drivers include income change crossing the 138% FPL or 200% FPL thresholds, loss of other coverage, marriage or divorce, birth or adoption of a child, moving to a new New York county, or turning 26 and losing a parent's coverage. Medicaid and Essential Plan enrollment are available year-round on NY State of Health with no SEP required.

en.question: Does the Black Car Fund provide health insurance for New York rideshare drivers?
en.answer: Not exactly. The Black Car Fund provides workers' compensation for on-the-job injuries and a free supplemental Drivers Benefits Program covering dental, vision, telemedicine, accident disability insurance, and a critical illness benefit for TLC-licensed drivers dispatched through Uber, Lyft, or a black car base. It is funded by a small per-trip passenger surcharge, not a stipend paid directly to drivers. The Black Car Fund is not a substitute for major medical health insurance; New York rideshare drivers still need Medicaid, the Essential Plan, or a Qualified Health Plan through NY State of Health for primary medical coverage.

en.question: Can New York gig workers enroll in a catastrophic plan?
en.answer: Yes, but only if under age 30 or holding a documented hardship exemption. New York gig workers over 30 without a hardship exemption are not eligible for catastrophic plans on NY State of Health. The 2026 catastrophic plan deductible is $10,600 for individual coverage, and catastrophic plans do not qualify for the federal Premium Tax Credit or the Essential Plan. Most New York rideshare and delivery drivers under 400% FPL are better served by Medicaid, the Essential Plan, or a subsidized Qualified Health Plan than by a catastrophic plan.

es.question: ¿Cual es el seguro medico mas barato para los conductores de viajes compartidos en Nueva York en 2026?
es.answer: Para los trabajadores gig de Nueva York que ganan menos de $22,025 (individual) en 2026, Medicaid a traves de NY State of Health es gratuito sin prima. Entre el 138% y el 200% FPL ($22,025 a $31,920 individual), el Essential Plan ofrece cobertura integral con una prima mensual de $0, aunque el limite de ingresos bajo del 250% al 200% FPL el 1 de julio de 2026. Por encima del 200% y hasta el 400% FPL, un Plan de Salud Calificado con el Credito Fiscal de Prima federal es la siguiente opcion mas economica.

es.question: ¿Los trabajadores gig de Nueva York califican para el Credito Fiscal de Prima?
es.answer: Si, si el MAGI neto anual esta entre el 200% y el 400% FPL, que es de $31,920 a $63,840 para un trabajador gig soltero en Nueva York en 2026. Por debajo del 200% FPL, los trabajadores gig de Nueva York califican en cambio para el Essential Plan gratuito (138% a 200% FPL) o Medicaid (por debajo del 138% FPL), ambos generalmente con mejor valor que un Plan de Salud Calificado subsidiado. El MAGI neto es el ingreso bruto 1099 menos deducciones comerciales, menos la mitad del impuesto al trabajo independiente, menos la deduccion del Formulario 7206.

es.question: ¿Pueden los trabajadores gig de Nueva York deducir las primas de seguro medico en los impuestos?
es.answer: Si, si tienen ingreso neto del trabajo independiente y no eran elegibles para cobertura patrocinada por el empleador en un mes determinado. El Formulario 7206 permite a los conductores de viajes compartidos, contratistas independientes y propietarios unicos de Nueva York deducir el 100% de las primas de seguro medico por encima de la linea, reduciendo tanto el impuesto sobre la renta federal como el estatal de Nueva York. Importante: el Formulario 7206 reduce el impuesto sobre la renta solamente. NO reduce el impuesto al trabajo independiente del 15.3% en el Schedule SE.

es.question: ¿Pueden los trabajadores gig de Nueva York usar una Cuenta de Ahorros para la Salud (HSA)?
es.answer: Si, si estan inscritos en un HDHP compatible con HSA a traves de NY State of Health. Para 2026, el deducible minimo del HDHP es $1,700 para cobertura individual o $3,400 para familia. El limite de contribucion al HSA en 2026 es $4,400 (individual) o $8,750 (familia), mas $1,000 adicional para los mayores de 55 anos. Una Cuenta de Gastos Flexibles (FSA) es solo para empleadores y NO esta disponible para los contratistas independientes, conductores de viajes compartidos o conductores de entrega que trabajan como contratistas 1099.

es.question: ¿Que pasa si un trabajador gig de Nueva York gana demasiado para el Essential Plan o los subsidios?
es.answer: Los trabajadores gig de Nueva York que ganan por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 individual, $132,000 para un hogar de cuatro en 2026) no reciben Creditos Fiscales de Prima federales. Los subsidios mejorados de ARPA y la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion vencieron el 1 de enero de 2026. A ese nivel de ingresos, la estrategia mas eficiente fiscalmente es un HDHP Bronze en NY State of Health combinado con un HSA maximizado ($4,400 individual / $8,750 familia).

es.question: ¿Cuando pueden los trabajadores gig de Nueva York inscribirse en un Plan de Salud Calificado fuera de la inscripcion abierta?
es.answer: Fuera de la ventana de inscripcion abierta del 1 de noviembre al 31 de enero, los trabajadores gig de Nueva York pueden inscribirse a traves de un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) del Mercado, que abre una ventana de 60 dias desde el evento calificador. Los activadores comunes incluyen cambio de ingresos que cruza los umbrales del 138% o 200% FPL, perdida de otra cobertura, matrimonio o divorcio, nacimiento o adopcion de un hijo, mudanza a un nuevo condado de Nueva York, o cumplir 26 anos y perder la cobertura de los padres.

es.question: ¿El Black Car Fund proporciona seguro medico para los conductores de viajes compartidos de Nueva York?
es.answer: No exactamente. El Black Car Fund proporciona compensacion laboral por lesiones en el trabajo y un Programa de Beneficios para Conductores suplementario y gratuito que cubre dental, vision, telemedicina, discapacidad por accidente y una prestacion por enfermedad critica para conductores con licencia TLC despachados a traves de Uber, Lyft o una base de black car. Se financia con un pequeno recargo por viaje pagado por los pasajeros, no un estipendio pagado directamente a los conductores. El Black Car Fund no es un sustituto de un seguro medico mayor.

es.question: ¿Pueden los trabajadores gig de Nueva York inscribirse en un plan catastrofico?
es.answer: Si, pero solo si son menores de 30 anos o tienen una exencion por dificultad documentada. Los trabajadores gig de Nueva York mayores de 30 anos sin exencion por dificultad no son elegibles para planes catastroficos en NY State of Health. El deducible del plan catastrofico de 2026 es $10,600 para cobertura individual, y los planes catastroficos no califican para el Credito Fiscal de Prima federal ni el Essential Plan.
